items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Another – we talked about Vashon High School and how you got oriented there. One person that we didn’t talk about was a name that came up in some of the literature, named Leonard Small.

Leonard Small was a trumpet player who comes from Tennessee, I think, but he was – he’s in Tennessee now. He was – he went to Vashon High School, and our instructor of the music department there, Clarence Heiden Wilson, was a very busy man. He had a lot of kids hanging on him, trying to get a hold of instruments and learn how to play and get involved in the orchestra and the band and the marching band, etc. So he would very often pawn us beginners off to somebody else who was a bit more experienced. So he pawned…
As a youth, what other interests did you have besides music?
